Technical cybersecurity requirement: Sign every remote driving command, assistance command and release with a key held in the station's hardware security module, bound to one vehicle's identity, with sequence number and time stamp (TSR-19.01)
Verification: Interface test; review of the key handling; penetration test of the station

Technical cybersecurity requirement: Verify the signature of every remote message, and reject one for another vehicle, out of sequence, older than P-09 or with a bad signature, before any of its content is used (TSR-05.02, TSR-06.05)
Verification: Fault injection of forged, replayed, misaddressed and aged messages (WP-S-05 SIG-01, SIG-02); fuzzing of the message parser

Technical cybersecurity requirement: Keep the verification keys and the vehicle identity in the hardware security module of the monitor's controller, readable only by the verification, and replaceable only through CSTR-05.01
Verification: Review of the controller's security manual (DQ-030 A); test that keys cannot be read out through EX-05

Technical cybersecurity requirement: Keep the link to the Autoware computer point to point, with no routing through the monitor, and accept on it only the messages of WP-S-05 SIG-03 to SIG-05; drop and count anything else
Verification: Fuzzing and flooding of IF-02; review of the network design

Technical cybersecurity requirement: Provide two cellular links on different networks, with separate modems and antennas, so that losing one network or one antenna leaves the other
Verification: Design review; field test with each link disabled

Technical cybersecurity requirement: Detect the loss of each link, switch to the other, and report the loss of both as TR-11 (WP-C-12)
Verification: Test with each link and both links cut while driving

Technical cybersecurity requirement: Accept a local release from a field technician only through an authenticated service tool on EX-05, with the release conditions of TSR-06.02, and log it
Verification: Test of the local release with valid and invalid credentials; review of the log

Technical cybersecurity requirement: Boot only firmware and envelope parameters signed with the project's release key, verified from immutable boot code; on a failed check stay silent, so that the vehicle does not move (MRM-5)
Verification: Test with unsigned, altered and old images; review of the boot chain

Technical cybersecurity requirement: Boot only signed firmware on the safety channel processor and its safety island; on a failed check report itself failed (SIG-10)
Verification: Test with unsigned and altered images

Technical cybersecurity requirement: Verify the boot chain of the Autoware computer, and verify every software, map and model package against its signature before install; install only out of service
Verification: Test with unsigned and altered packages; test that install is refused in service

Technical cybersecurity requirement: Check at start that the software, map, model and parameter versions form one released set, and refuse to enter service otherwise
Verification: Test with each part of the set changed alone

Technical cybersecurity requirement: Keep a monotonic counter in the controller that refuses older firmware and parameters than those installed
Verification: Rollback test

Technical cybersecurity requirement: Be the only node of the safety and vehicle zones with a path to the Autoware zone, and forward nothing between them
Verification: Network review; test that no message from the Autoware computer reaches the by-wire bus

Technical cybersecurity requirement: Close the monitor's debug ports in production, open them only with an authenticated unlock that erases the keys, and seal the housing (CR-03)
Verification: Test of the production debug state; inspection of the seal

Technical cybersecurity requirement: Include the known physical attacks on LiDAR and radar (spoofed returns, jamming, relays) in the detection and false-detection tests of TSR-09.01 to TSR-09.06, and report a sensor whose data is implausible as degraded (TSR-10.01)
Verification: Attack tests on the bench and on the track with the sensors chosen (WP-H-02)

Technical cybersecurity requirement: Test Autoware's perception against the known adversarial patches and sensor attacks for the ODD, and keep the list current with the threat monitoring of WP-O-05
Verification: Attack tests in replay and on the track; review of the list

Technical cybersecurity requirement: Accept an initial pose only when scan matching against the map and the last known pose agree with it; never take a GNSS fix alone
Verification: Tests with spoofed and displaced GNSS fixes at start-up

Technical cybersecurity requirement: Yield to an emergency vehicle only when sound and light confirm each other, and report every yield where no emergency vehicle is plausible to remote operations
Verification: Tests with siren only, lights only and both; review of the reports

Technical cybersecurity requirement: Accept a change of destination or route from the backend only when it is signed, show it to the passenger, and act on it only after the passenger or an operator confirms it
Verification: Tests with unsigned, unconfirmed and confirmed route changes

Technical cybersecurity requirement: Accept from the passenger interface and the passenger app only the stop request and door commands, rate-limited, and pass door commands to the door system without overriding its interlocks
Verification: Fuzzing of the passenger interface; tests with every other command

Technical cybersecurity requirement: Act on a door command only within the door system's own interlocks, whatever the passenger interface sends (TSR-17.01)
Verification: Supplier evidence; vehicle test
